name: destination_id
description: Unique destination identifier, e.g. DST-007. Joins to packages.destination_id and appears in web_sessions.destinations_viewed.

name: name
description: Customer-facing destination name, e.g. Aruba, Whistler, Alaska Inside Passage.

name: region
description: Marketing region, e.g. Caribbean, Hawaii, Canadian Rockies, Mediterranean.

name: category
description: Product category: one of warm_escape (winter and early-spring sun getaways, our signature category), city_break, ski, adventure, cruise.

name: description
description: 120–200 word customer-facing description in the brand voice. This text is embedded in catalog_embeddings for semantic search.

name: price_band
description: Relative price positioning: budget, mid, premium or luxury.

name: best_months
description: Calendar months (1–12) when the destination is at its best for travel.

name: highlights
description: Five short phrases naming the destination's signature experiences.

name: good_for
description: Traveler types the destination suits, e.g. couples, families, active travelers.
